**1h**

I just finished up designing my PCB and exported the files. It took me way longer than it should have to figure out how to add an image on to the PCB, but I eventually figured it out. After that, I exported all of the design and manufacturing files and put them in my project's GitHub. Now I just need to work on the firmware. I am currently considering redesigning the project to have more buttons.
